summary: The diff implements an access-code gate UI with localStorage persistence, adds day-specific floating item assets in the animation, and adds a Feb 14 Valentine’s Day experience with a hearts celebration. However, the core data-flow/authorization changes to remove Principal/Internet Identity dependency and to enforce access-code validation in the backend are not implemented; the backend and frontend still use caller Principal-based endpoints. Also, the Valentine’s Day option labels are not exactly as specified, and required icon image files are referenced but not shown as added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update frontend data-flow so the app works without Internet Identity by using a locally-generated persisted clientId for all profile/progress reads and writes, and update backend endpoints accordingly.
missing_requirements.reason: Although a clientId is generated and used in React Query keys, the actual actor calls still use Principal-based methods (e.g., getCallerUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile, getUserValentineData, claimDay) and no backend endpoints accepting (clientId, accessCode) are shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Modify backend authorization to validate the correct access code phrase for profile reads/writes and progress reads/day claims, and store data keyed by clientId (Text) instead of caller Principal.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend still stores maps keyed by Principal and gates operations via AccessControl permissions rather than validating the provided code phrase; no (clientId, codePhrase) parameters are present in the shown endpoints.

missing_requirements.requirement: Valentine’s Day (Feb 14) experience must show exactly two options labeled "Yes" and "Ofcourse".
missing_requirements.reason: The two buttons are labeled "1. Yes" and "2. Ofcourse" rather than exactly "Yes" and "Ofcourse".

missing_requirements.requirement: Add the required day-specific floating item icon image files (teddy, chocolate, ring, promise, hug, kiss icons).
missing_requirements.reason: The UI references these asset paths, but the diff does not show the actual image files being added.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend role/permission-based authorization system (AccessControl / MixinAuthorization) used to authorize profile/data access.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest requires access-code phrase validation, not a permission/admin authorization model.

hallucinated_features.description: Added an upgrade migration module that performs no migration (identity mapping unchanged).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest says to add migration.mo only if upgrade-safe migration is actually required; the new migration module is a no-op and does not address the required Principal->clientId storage change.

hallucinated_features.description: Extra non-requested branding/footer content (© 2026, caffeine.ai link) and access-gate hint text.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in the BuildRequest requirements/AC; these are additional UI elements.
